description: This file provides a service function 'inviteUserAsFounder' that handles inviting a user as a 'founder' via Supabase Auth. It manages the invitation process, including sending a magic link, and attempts to assign the 'founder' role by calling a backend RPC. The function provides feedback on success or failure.

methods.name: inviteUserAsFounder(email, siteUrl)
methods.description: Asynchronously invites a user as a 'founder' by sending an email magic link and assigning roles via a backend RPC call. Validates email, handles errors, and returns success status.
